== Notes ==
* This spell is often utilized by Monks in [[PvP]] using a technique called [[pre-veil]]ing.
* Recasting this spell on a target on which it is still active will not remove a hex.
* [[Hero]]es use Holy Veil effectively to remove hexes as they immediately stop maintaining this enchantment.
* The [[foe]] [[AI]] (e.g. [[Juniper Bark]]s) will continue to maintain Holy Veil when they are hexed and will not stop maintaining it to remove a hex.
